name: design-helper
description: Settle CSS values, layout and motion by eye: draws every candidate side by side in the browser, you pick one, and it applies the choice to your code.

interface.shortDescription: Compare CSS values side by side and pick by eye
interface.longDescription: Instead of describing options in prose, design-helper draws every candidate for one property side by side in your browser. You pick a letter in chat, and it applies the chosen value to your code and verifies it. Replies and sheet labels are in Korean by default.
defaultPrompt: Show me 5 versions of the button radius
